title: CLIPure: Purification in Latent Space via CLIP for Adversarially Robust Zero-Shot Classification
abstract: arXiv:2502.18176v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we aim to build an adversarially robust zero-shot image classifier. We ground our work on CLIP, a vision-language pre-trained encoder model that can perform zero-shot classification by matching an image with text prompts ``a photo of a .''. Purification is the path we choose since it does not require adversarial training on specific attack types and thus can cope with any foreseen attacks. We then formulate purification risk as the KL divergence between the joint distributions of the purification process of denoising the adversarial samples and the attack process of adding perturbations to benign samples, through bidirectional Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs). The final derived results inspire us to explore purification in the multi-modal latent space of CLIP. We propose two variants for our CLIPure approach: CLIPure-Diff which models the likelihood of images' latent vectors with the DiffusionPrior module

translated_title: CLIPure：通过CLIP在潜在空间中进行净化以实现对抗鲁棒的零样本分类
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们旨在构建一个对抗鲁棒的零样本图像分类器。我们的工作基于CLIP，这是一个视觉-语言预训练编码器模型，可以通过将图像与文本提示"a photo of a ."进行匹配来执行零样本分类。我们选择净化作为技术路径，因为它不需要针对特定攻击类型进行对抗训练，因此能够应对任何可预见的攻击。随后，我们通过双向随机微分方程（SDE），将净化风险形式化为净化过程（对对抗样本去噪）与攻击过程（对良性样本添加扰动）的联合分布之间的KL散度。最终推导出的结果启发我们探索在CLIP的多模态潜在空间中进行净化。我们提出了CLIPure方法的两个变体：CLIPure-Diff，它使用DiffusionPrior模块对图像潜在向量的似然进行建模……
tldr: 本文提出CLIPure方法，将净化风险形式化为双向随机微分方程下净化过程与攻击过程联合分布之间的KL散度，通过在CLIP的多模态潜在空间中进行净化，构建了无需针对特定攻击进行对抗训练即可实现对抗鲁棒的零样本图像分类器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CLIPure, which formulates purification risk as the KL divergence between the joint distributions of purification and attack processes via bidirectional SDEs, and achieves adversarially robust zero-shot image classification by purification in CLIP's multi-modal latent space without adversarial training on specific attack types.
